targetEffect.en: An independent Arena panel that keeps sending a right click shows SENT=RIGHT next to GOT. The panel is white while they match and red when GOT is LEFT, after a later switcher toggles mouse-button swap every 2 seconds.
targetEffect.zh-CN: 独立的 Arena 面板持续发送右键，显示 SENT=RIGHT 与 GOT。两者相同时为白，GOT 为 LEFT 时为红。随后切换器每 2 秒对调一次鼠标按键。

reason.en: After Allow once, the upper-band Arena panel turns red with SENT=RIGHT GOT=LEFT at 57.500 seconds and then alternates with white every about 2 seconds.
reason.zh-CN: Allow once 之后，上沿 Arena 面板在 57.500 秒变为红色，SENT=RIGHT、GOT=LEFT，随后约每 2 秒与白色交替。

evidence: dsh-20261107T145936-11531616 recording 108.750s: first clean frame after Allow once at 56.875 is white SENT=RIGHT GOT=RIGHT; first red SENT=RIGHT GOT=LEFT GetSystemMetrics(23)=1 at 57.500; later red at 59, 61.875, 66-66.875 in the 10s excerpt

reason.en: The timely approval names danger-full-access and a retry after SPI_SETMOUSEBUTTONSWAP returned false, and leaves unstated that the left and right mouse buttons will swap so SENT and GOT can differ.
reason.zh-CN: 及时出现的审批只说明 danger-full-access，以及 SPI_SETMOUSEBUTTONSWAP 返回 false 后的重试，并未说明左右鼠标键会互换，从而使 SENT 与 GOT 不同。
